items.title: Russell Brand was a 'sexual predator', prosecution alleges as rape trial begins
items.summary: The comedian and actor faces charges including rape and sexual assault from six female complainants who have never met each other, a court is told.

items.title: Pope thanks wellwishers for prayers after cancer operation
items.summary: Pope Leo has thanked wellwishers for their prayers after his cancer operation.

items.title: Family pays tribute to 'warm and engaging' man killed in tiger attack
items.summary: William Chapman was attacked by the tiger after he entered its pen at Yorkshire Wildlife Park.

items.title: Trump posts video of UK tiger attack - as victim's family say online content causing 'severe distress'
items.summary: The family of a man killed by a tiger have said "deeply offensive content is causing them severe distress".

items.title: We are behind you and that will not change, PM tells Zelensky
items.summary: The Ukrainian president visited London in an effort to bolster support among European allies following a row with Donald Trump.

items.title: Children killed in arson attack named - as family calls for culprit to 'own up'
items.summary: Two children who died in an arson attack at a home in Ireland have been named as Callum and Jayden, as their family and police urge anyone with information to come forward.
